I wrote the page to `solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it's untested.

- **Trigger:** a secondary "Delete project" button opens the modal.
- **Dialog:** it's built on the workspace's `alert-dialog` component, which is a modal and has the title and description you gave.
- **Actions:** "Keep project" just closes the dialog. The primary "Delete" button closes it and sets the status text "Project deleted." on the page.
- **Status text:** it sits in a `role="status"` live region, so screen readers announce it.
- **Brand:** the page uses theme classes only (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`), so it follows the active brand. I added the background and padding myself because the host page doesn't supply any.
